event_summary: A paintbrush moves over a transparent sheet, contacts a red spot, and leaves a curved red streak on the sheet.
raw_event_description: At the start, a transparent rectangular sheet lies on a wooden tabletop with a small red circular spot near its upper central area. A white-handled paintbrush with orange-red bristles is partly visible at the right side near a black round base with green parts. The brush moves from the right side onto the sheet, travels diagonally inward across the lower-right area, approaches the red spot, and the bristle tip overlaps the red spot. The red spot then changes shape, and red material becomes spread into an elongated curved streak as the brush continues moving toward the upper-right side. Near the end, the brush is mostly out of view to the right, while the curved red streak remains on the transparent sheet.

reasons: The transparent sheet, red spot, tabletop, right-side base, and brush are visible before the brush reaches the red spot.
The red spot is still compact and circular in the first frame.
The brush is visible at the right side and not yet overlapping the red spot.
